experiments.hypothesis: one-element aggregate arrays may preserve the transition and channel subobject bases

experiments.hypothesis: the policy-permitted three-instruction inline-asm fallback can isolate only the stubborn transition store
experiments.result: MWCC optimized the asm statements and changed long-lived register allocation, producing a materially worse object; the experiment was not retained.

divergence: Retail emits addi r3,r29,0x21c followed by li r0,1 and stw r0,0x18(r3); generated C folds the address into li r0,1 plus stw r0,0x234(r29). Retail also loads the initial channel index as lwz r0,0x4(r6), while generated C uses lwz r0,0x1e4(r29). All 30 actual ELF relocation types, targets, and addends agree in corresponding order, with generated relocation offsets four bytes earlier after the omitted transition addi.
